system.description: Assists with breathing in a thin atmosphere (type 3 or less), using a supplemental compressed air tank to provide the air needed.
Necessary for breathing in a tainted atmosphere (types 4, 7, and 9).
This mask provides the benefit of both the respirator and filter mask.

A compressed oxygen tank used for respirators, vaccsuits, and scuba.

Refill: 20cr.
In aquatic environments, this allows the wearer to breathe normally underwater without needing an external compressed tank.
Used for long-term underwater swimming. It includes a respirator, air tank, fins, insulated wet suit, and goggles.
HPS are used to protect the wearer from corrosive (type B) and insidious atmospheres (type C) as well as radiation for up to 12 hours. Functions as cloth armour.

Vaccsuits provide protection from the vacuum of space in addition to what HPS provides, while providing communications and air to breathe. Each vaccsuit type by tech level provides longer duration of use.

  • Air supply: 8 hours of air
  • Corrosive/hazardous atmospheres: 8 hours
  • Comms: 5km of communication range (Medium Range)
  • Radiation protection up to 80 rads
  • Armour: Equal to cloth armour

All vaccsuits have attachment points for equipment and additional modifications such as extra air tanks, holsters, climbing harness, backpacks, etc.

Same as the vaccsuit of the prior tech level but has the following upgrades:

  • 9 hours of effective time
  • Long communication range (250m)
  • Protection against up to 90 rads

Same as the vaccsuit of the prior tech level but has the following upgrades:

  • 10 hours of effective time
  • Very Long communication range (500m)
  • Protection against up to 100 rads

Same as the vaccsuit of the prior tech level but has the following upgrades:

  • 11 hours of effective time
  • Distant communication range (5km)
  • Protection against up to 110 rads

Same as the vaccsuit of the prior tech level but has the following upgrades:

  • 12 hours of effective time
  • Far communication range (50km)
  • Protection against up to 120 rads

Same as the vaccsuit of the prior tech level but has the following upgrades:

  • Far communication range (50km)
  • Protection against up to 130 rads
Protects the wearer from arctic temperatures up to -25 Celsius and doubles as jack armour.
Protects the wearer from arctic temperatures up to -50 Celsius and doubles as jack armour.

An automatic and instantly inflating personal atmosphere that is 2m in diametre, which protects a single person for eight hours against external hazards and the vacuum of space. On a planet's surface, the individual in the bubble can walk inside like a hamster ball.

An adhesive-backed fabric weave used to patch punctures in a vaccsuit in an emergency. Vacctape comes in a roll with up to ten applications. Any vaccsuit with punctures decreases in effective time of use by 1 hour after taping. A vaccsuit with 8 punctures is non-usable.
